questions.stem: A 26-year-old woman posted for LSCS under spinal anesthesia was given 2.8ml of 0.5% heavy bupivacaine in the subarachnoid space. Her BP fell from 120/80 mm Hg to 70/40 mm Hg. What should be the next step?
